spans.s: bīravaṇa-pārikhāya (IA 19), levy stated to have been of four kinds; cf. nidhi-nikṣepa-jala-pāṣāṇ-ārām-ādi-chatuṣ-prakāra-bīravaṇa-pārikhāya-sahitaṃ which is mentioned along with aṣṭabhogatejassvāmya-daṇḍa-śulka-yuktam; Sanskrit vīra-paṇa (tax for the maintenance of constables) and pārīkṣ-āya (pārīkṣika).
